tagline: Standalone music player with adaptive vocal isolation
changelog: VocalPure is now a standalone app — a complete music player, fully separate from the download website
Improved isolation engine: every song is analyzed with FFT and the strongest strategy is picked per track (center extraction, center blend, or frequency focus)
Sharper karaoke: multi-band side extraction with bass return, deeper vocal-band notch on mono files
Cleaner vocals-only: 3-band mid extraction with presence boost and per-stem limiting
Library, playlists, favorites, search, queue, 5-band EQ, sleep timer and playback speed
WAV export saves straight to your phone (Music/VocalPure)
